# Three.js · 16 Orbit Controls and On-Demand Rendering

[Series contents](../../README.md) · [Technology map](../../../../README.md)

Stage: Animation, Instancing, and Render Passes · Editable example · Storage ID: `threejs-step-16`

## Goals and learning outcomes

- Update the screen after input and resizing.
- Keep frames running during damping.

## Prerequisites

Prerequisite units: 02, 03, 15. Apply their concepts in these experiments.

## Key concepts and explanations

### Look point and orbit center

target uses world coordinates. A model local origin need not be the world origin. Failing to update after a target change can cause an abrupt turn on the next input.

### Update through damping

Enabling damping does not create a loop automatically. Keep calling update through the settling period, then wait for input once stable.

## Practice setup

Edit and run independent HTML in the site using Three.js 0.186.1 and addons from the same installation. No separate installation or server is needed. Existing JavaScript drafts are preserved.

Complete every required task inside the site, step by step. Load a starter from the learning steps below, edit and run it, then record the actual results and reasons in the site notes.

## Practice tasks

1. After loading static, root.position.x=4 moves the model. The camera is fit to the model but target X starts at 0, so it looks toward the origin. Enter target X=4 and Apply. controls.target is a Vector3, distinct from camera.position. Changing only the center changes view direction and orbit.

Drag horizontally and zoom with the wheel. Orbit once also rotates the camera offset .25rad around target. Compare identical actions at target 0 and 4; record target coordinates and model location. controls.update() applies manual camera/target changes. 2. Damping starts off. Enable it, Apply, drag the canvas, and release. With enableDamping=true and dampingFactor=.15, each update reduces remaining rotation. Drawing once cannot show that continuation.

frame schedules requestAnimationFrame while controls.update() returns true. A change event wakes new input. insideFrame prevents update-driven change events from double-scheduling. Once movement settles, false ends scheduling. Observe frames continuing briefly after release, then stopping. 3. Demand rendering starts off, so frames keeps increasing without input. Enable it and Apply. Once the camera settles, frames should stop. Drag or change target and confirm both the count and image resume updating.

invalidate schedules only when raf is absent. frame clears the scheduled marker, updates controls, and draws. It reschedules when demand=false or controls are still moving. Resize also invalidates, so opening a hidden 390 preview updates it. Cleanup cancels the pending frame and controls.dispose() removes control listeners.

## Guided learning

Continue sizing, OrbitControls, and camera fitting from 02, 03, and 15. target is the orbit center; damping continues motion after input. Read frames to compare continuous and on-demand rendering. This model has no animation, so idle rendering can stop.

### Prerequisite units

- `threejs-step-02`
- `threejs-step-03`
- `threejs-step-15`

### Look point and orbit center

After loading static, root.position.x=4 moves the model. The camera is fit to the model but target X starts at 0, so it looks toward the origin. Enter target X=4 and Apply. controls.target is a Vector3, distinct from camera.position. Changing only the center changes view direction and orbit.

Drag horizontally and zoom with the wheel. Orbit once also rotates the camera offset .25rad around target. Compare identical actions at target 0 and 4; record target coordinates and model location. controls.update() applies manual camera/target changes.

**Expected result**

At target X=4, the panels are centered and orbit around that center. frames increases during interaction.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
    <title>The orbit target</title>
    <style>
      body { margin:0; padding:12px; font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; color:#172554; background:white; } h1{font-size:22px} #stage{width:480px;max-width:100%;height:280px} canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none} .controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px} input[type=number]{width:78px} input[type=file]{width:240px;max-width:100%} button{padding:6px} output{display:block;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere} #error{color:#b91c1c}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>The orbit target</h1>
    <p>
      Original two-panel GLB. static shares geometry and material; animated
      moves Left from X=-1.1 to -.1 in one second. textured embeds a 2×2 PNG.
      Files exist only during this run and are excluded from backups. Reselect
      after re-run, reload, or backup restore. GLB external URIs, multi-file
      .gltf, and Draco/Meshopt/KTX2 compression are unsupported here. After
      failure, choose another file or a built-in model and click Load sample.
    </p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label
        >Built-in model
        <select id="model">
          <option>static</option>
          <option>animated</option>
          <option>empty</option>
          <option>textured</option>
          <option>offset</option>
        </select></label
      ><button id="sample">Load sample</button
      ><button id="invalid">Try corrupt GLB</button
      ><label
        >GLB file (max 2 MiB)
        <input id="file" type="file" accept=".glb,model/gltf-binary" /></label
      ><label
        >target X
        <input
          id="value"
          type="number"
          min="0"
          max="4"
          step="0.5"
          value="0" /></label
      ><label><input id="damping" type="checkbox" checked />damping</label
      ><label
        ><input id="demand" type="checkbox" checked />Demand rendering</label
      ><button id="apply">Apply</button><button id="orbit">Orbit once</button
      ><button id="cleanup">Dispose resources</button>
    </div>
    <p id="error" role="status"></p>
    <div id="stage"><canvas aria-label="The orbit target"></canvas></div>
    <output></output>
    <script type="module">
      import * as THREE from 'three';
      const stage = document.querySelector('#stage'),
        canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'),
        output = document.querySelector('output'),
        error = document.querySelector('#error');
      const scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color('#edf2f7');
      const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.01, 1000);
      camera.position.set(0, 0, 7);
      camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
      const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
      renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
      const events = new AbortController();
      let disposed = false,
        frames = 0;
      const ownedGeometry = new Set(),
        ownedMaterial = new Set(),
        ownedTextures = new Set(),
        ownedTargets = new Set();
      const on = (selector, type, fn) =>
        document
          .querySelector(selector)
          .addEventListener(type, fn, { signal: events.signal });
      import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
      const samples = {
        static:
          '',
        animated:
          '',
        empty:
          'Z2xURgIAAAB4AAAAZAAAAEpTT057ImFzc2V0Ijp7InZlcnNpb24iOiIyLjAiLCJnZW5lcmF0b3IiOiJGcm9udG9yeSBhdXRob3JlZCBwYW5lbHMifSwic2NlbmUiOjAsInNjZW5lcyI6W3sibm9kZXMiOltdfV19',
        textured:
          '',
        offset:
          '',
      };
      const loader = new GLTFLoader();
      let root = null,
        meshes = [],
        status = 'loading',
        request = 0,
        sharedAtLoad = false;
      const restoreSelection = () => {};

      import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
      const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);
      controls.enableDamping = true;
      controls.dampingFactor = 0.15;
      const box = new THREE.Box3(),
        center = new THREE.Vector3(),
        size = new THREE.Vector3();
      let empty = false;
      const useCenter = true,
        useFov = true,
        guardEmpty = true;
      function fitModel() {
        if (!root) return;
        root.updateWorldMatrix(true, true);
        box.setFromObject(root);
        empty = box.isEmpty();
        if (empty) {
          error.textContent =
            'Empty model: no drawable surface. Choose another built-in model.';
          if (guardEmpty) return;
        }
        box.getCenter(center);
        box.getSize(size);
        const focus = useCenter ? center : new THREE.Vector3();
        const radius = Math.max(size.length() / 2, 0.001),
          vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov),
          hFov = 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(vFov / 2) * camera.aspect),
          margin = 1.25;
        const distance = useFov
          ? (radius / Math.sin(Math.min(vFov, hFov) / 2)) * margin
          : 7;
        controls.target.copy(focus);
        camera.position.copy(focus).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, distance));
        camera.near = Math.max(distance - radius * 2, 0.00001);
        camera.far = distance + radius * 4;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        controls.update();
      }

      let raf = 0,
        demand = document.querySelector('#demand').checked,
        insideFrame = false;
      function invalidate() {
        if (!disposed && !raf && !insideFrame) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
      function frame() {
        raf = 0;
        if (disposed) return;
        insideFrame = true;
        const moving = controls.update();
        draw();
        insideFrame = false;
        if (!demand || moving) invalidate();
      }
      controls.addEventListener('change', invalidate);
      controls.addEventListener('start', invalidate);
      on('#apply', 'click', () => {
        const input = document.querySelector('#value');
        if (!input.value || !input.checkValidity()) return;
        controls.target.x = Number(input.value);
        controls.enableDamping = document.querySelector('#damping').checked;
        demand = document.querySelector('#demand').checked;
        controls.update();
        invalidate();
      });
      on('#orbit', 'click', () => {
        const offset = camera.position
          .clone()
          .sub(controls.target)
          .applyAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.25);
        camera.position.copy(controls.target).add(offset);
        controls.update();
        invalidate();
      });

      const clearMixer = () => {};
      function resources(object) {
        const geometry = new Set(),
          material = new Set(),
          texture = new Set();
        object.traverse((o) => {
          if (o.geometry) geometry.add(o.geometry);
          for (const m of Array.isArray(o.material)
            ? o.material
            : o.material
              ? [o.material]
              : []) {
            material.add(m);
            for (const value of Object.values(m))
              if (value?.isTexture) texture.add(value);
          }
        });
        return { geometry, material, texture };
      }
      function release(object) {
        const r = resources(object);
        for (const g of r.geometry) {
          ownedGeometry.delete(g);
          g.dispose();
        }
        for (const m of r.material) {
          ownedMaterial.delete(m);
          m.dispose();
        }
        for (const tex of r.texture) {
          ownedTextures.delete(tex);
          tex.dispose();
          tex.image?.close?.();
        }
      }
      function validateGlb(buffer) {
        if (buffer.byteLength > 2 * 1024 * 1024) throw Error('GLB exceeds 2 MiB');
        const view = new DataView(buffer);
        if (
          view.getUint32(0, true) !== 0x46546c67 ||
          view.getUint32(4, true) !== 2 ||
          view.getUint32(8, true) !== buffer.byteLength ||
          view.getUint32(16, true) !== 0x4e4f534a
        )
          throw Error('Invalid GLB');
        const json = JSON.parse(
          new TextDecoder().decode(
            new Uint8Array(buffer, 20, view.getUint32(12, true)),
          ),
        );
        if (
          [...(json.buffers ?? []), ...(json.images ?? [])].some(
            (x) => x.uri && !x.uri.startsWith('data:'),
          )
        )
          throw Error('External URI unsupported');
        if ((json.extensionsUsed ?? []).some((x) => /draco|meshopt|basisu/i.test(x)))
          throw Error('Compression unsupported');
      }
      async function loadModel(readBuffer) {
        const token = ++request;
        status = 'loading';
        error.textContent = '';
        draw();
        try {
          const buffer = await readBuffer();
          validateGlb(buffer);
          const gltf = await loader.parseAsync(buffer, '');
          if (disposed || token !== request) {
            release(gltf.scene);
            return;
          }
          restoreSelection();
          clearMixer();
          if (root) {
            scene.remove(root);
            release(root);
          }
          root = gltf.scene;
          scene.add(root);
          meshes = [];
          root.traverse((o) => {
            if (o.isMesh) meshes.push(o);
          });
          const r = resources(root);
          r.geometry.forEach((x) => ownedGeometry.add(x));
          r.material.forEach((x) => ownedMaterial.add(x));
          r.texture.forEach((x) => ownedTextures.add(x));
          sharedAtLoad =
            meshes.length > 1 && meshes[0].material === meshes[1].material;
          status = 'ready';

          fitModel();
          if (root) {
            root.position.x = 4;
            fitModel();
            controls.target.x = Number(document.querySelector('#value').value);
            controls.update();
          }
          invalidate();
          draw();
        } catch (cause) {
          if (disposed || token !== request) return;
          status = 'error';
          error.textContent =
            'Could not read GLB. Choose a self-contained uncompressed GLB up to 2 MiB, or load a built-in sample. Details: ' +
            cause.message;
          draw();
        }
      }
      function sample(kind) {
        if (kind in samples) document.querySelector('#model').value = kind;
        return loadModel(() =>
          kind === 'invalid'
            ? new TextEncoder().encode('invalid-glb').buffer
            : Uint8Array.from(atob(samples[kind]), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer,
        );
      }
      on('#sample', 'click', () => {
        document.querySelector('#file').value = '';
        sample(document.querySelector('#model').value);
      });
      on('#invalid', 'click', () => sample('invalid'));
      on('#file', 'change', (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (file) loadModel(() => file.arrayBuffer());
      });
      sample('static');
      function report() {
        output.textContent =
          'State: ' +
          status +
          ' / meshes: ' +
          meshes.length +
          ' / shared at load: ' +
          sharedAtLoad +
          ' / frames: ' +
          frames +
          ' / target: ' +
          controls.target.toArray().map((x) => x.toFixed(2)) +
          ' / damping: ' +
          controls.enableDamping +
          ' / demand: ' +
          demand;
      }
      function draw() {
        if (disposed || !stage.clientWidth || !stage.clientHeight) return;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        frames++;
        report();
      }
      function resizeScene() {
        const w = stage.clientWidth,
          h = stage.clientHeight;
        if (!w || !h || disposed) return;
        renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
        camera.aspect = w / h;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        invalidate();
        draw();
      }
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(resizeScene);
      observer.observe(stage);
      resizeScene();
      function cleanup() {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        observer.disconnect();
        events.abort();
        renderer.setAnimationLoop(null);
        request++;
        restoreSelection();
        clearMixer();
        controls.dispose();
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        for (const texture of ownedTextures) {
          texture.dispose();
          texture.image?.close?.();
        }
        for (const g of ownedGeometry) g.dispose();
        for (const m of ownedMaterial) m.dispose();
        renderer.dispose();
        scene.clear();
        output.textContent = 'Disposed';
      }
      on('#cleanup', 'click', cleanup);
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', cleanup, {
        once: true,
        signal: events.signal,
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

</details>

- What happens if camera position and target coincide?
- Why does world-space target matter?

### Update through damping

Damping starts off. Enable it, Apply, drag the canvas, and release. With enableDamping=true and dampingFactor=.15, each update reduces remaining rotation. Drawing once cannot show that continuation.

frame schedules requestAnimationFrame while controls.update() returns true. A change event wakes new input. insideFrame prevents update-driven change events from double-scheduling. Once movement settles, false ends scheduling. Observe frames continuing briefly after release, then stopping.

**Expected result**

With damping, camera and frames continue briefly after release, then stop. Without it, the view settles immediately after input.

- The update return value controls the next frame.

<details>
<summary>Solution and explanation</summary>

Enabling damping does not create a loop automatically. Keep calling update through the settling period, then wait for input once stable.

```html
              : []) {
            material.add(m);
            for (const value of Object.values(m))
              if (value?.isTexture) texture.add(value);

          g.dispose();

        for (const m of r.material) {
          ownedMaterial.delete(m);
          m.dispose();
        }
        for (const tex of r.texture) {
          ownedTextures.delete(tex);
          tex.dispose();
          tex.image?.close?.();

        if (buffer.byteLength > 2 * 1024 * 1024) throw Error('GLB exceeds 2 MiB');

          view.getUint32(0, true) !== 0x46546c67 ||
          view.getUint32(4, true) !== 2 ||

            new Uint8Array(buffer, 20, view.getUint32(12, true)),
          ),
        );
        if (
          [...(json.buffers ?? []), ...(json.images ?? [])].some(
            (x) => x.uri && !x.uri.startsWith('data:'),
          )
        )
          throw Error('External URI unsupported');
        if ((json.extensionsUsed ?? []).some((x) => /draco|meshopt|basisu/i.test(x)))
          throw Error('Compression unsupported');

        const token = ++request;
        status = 'loading';
        error.textContent = '';

          const buffer = await readBuffer();

            return;

          r.material.forEach((x) => ownedMaterial.add(x));

        sample(document.querySelector('#model').value);

        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (file) loadModel(() => file.arrayBuffer());

        output.textContent =
          'State: ' +
          status +
          ' / meshes: ' +
          meshes.length +
          ' / shared at load: ' +
          sharedAtLoad +
          ' / frames: ' +
          frames +
          ' / target: ' +
          controls.target.toArray().map((x) => x.toFixed(2)) +
          ' / damping: ' +
          controls.enableDamping +
          ' / demand: ' +
          demand;
      }

        if (disposed || !stage.clientWidth || !stage.clientHeight) return;

        frames++;
        report();

          h = stage.clientHeight;

        observer.disconnect();

        clearMixer();
        controls.dispose();
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);

          texture.dispose();
          texture.image?.close?.();
        }
        for (const g of ownedGeometry) g.dispose();
        for (const m of ownedMaterial) m.dispose();
        renderer.dispose();
        scene.clear();
        output.textContent = 'Disposed';
      }
      on('#cleanup', 'click', cleanup);
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', cleanup, {
        once: true,
        signal: events.signal,
      });
    </script>
```

</details>

- Why is one update insufficient with damping?
- Which flag prevents duplicate scheduling from change and update?

### Continuous and on-demand rendering

Demand rendering starts off, so frames keeps increasing without input. Enable it and Apply. Once the camera settles, frames should stop. Drag or change target and confirm both the count and image resume updating.

invalidate schedules only when raf is absent. frame clears the scheduled marker, updates controls, and draws. It reschedules when demand=false or controls are still moving. Resize also invalidates, so opening a hidden 390 preview updates it. Cleanup cancels the pending frame and controls.dispose() removes control listeners.

**Expected result**

Off: count rises while idle. On: it stops after settling and resumes during input and damping.

<details>
<summary>Hints</summary>

- Do not call extra draw while reading the idle count.
- Change demand independently of damping.
- Enable demand, Apply, and record idle → drag → idle.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Solution and explanation</summary>

On-demand rendering reduces unnecessary render calls in a static scene. An ongoing animation must keep scheduling updates while it changes. frames counts render calls in this example, not GPU time or browser-wide FPS.

```html
        if (disposed) return;
        insideFrame = true;
        const moving = controls.update();
        draw();
        insideFrame = false;
        if (!demand || moving) invalidate();
      }
      controls.addEventListener('change', invalidate);
      controls.addEventListener('start', invalidate);
      on('#apply', 'click', () => {
        const input = document.querySelector('#value');
        if (!input.value || !input.checkValidity()) return;
        controls.target.x = Number(input.value);
        controls.enableDamping = document.querySelector('#damping').checked;
        demand = document.querySelector('#demand').checked;
        controls.update();
        invalidate();
      });
      on('#orbit', 'click', () => {
        const offset = camera.position
          .clone()
          .sub(controls.target)
          .applyAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.25);
        camera.position.copy(controls.target).add(offset);
        controls.update();
        invalidate();
      });

      const clearMixer = () => {};
      function resources(object) {
        const geometry = new Set(),
          material = new Set(),
          texture = new Set();
        object.traverse((o) => {
          if (o.geometry) geometry.add(o.geometry);
          for (const m of Array.isArray(o.material)
            ? o.material
            : o.material
              ? [o.material]
              : []) {
            material.add(m);
            for (const value of Object.values(m))
              if (value?.isTexture) texture.add(value);
          }
        });
        return { geometry, material, texture };
      }
      function release(object) {
        const r = resources(object);
        for (const g of r.geometry) {
          ownedGeometry.delete(g);
          g.dispose();
        }
        for (const m of r.material) {
          ownedMaterial.delete(m);
          m.dispose();
        }
        for (const tex of r.texture) {
          ownedTextures.delete(tex);
          tex.dispose();
          tex.image?.close?.();
        }
      }
      function validateGlb(buffer) {
        if (buffer.byteLength > 2 * 1024 * 1024) throw Error('GLB exceeds 2 MiB');
        const view = new DataView(buffer);
        if (
          view.getUint32(0, true) !== 0x46546c67 ||
          view.getUint32(4, true) !== 2 ||
          view.getUint32(8, true) !== buffer.byteLength ||
          view.getUint32(16, true) !== 0x4e4f534a
        )
          throw Error('Invalid GLB');
        const json = JSON.parse(
          new TextDecoder().decode(
            new Uint8Array(buffer, 20, view.getUint32(12, true)),
          ),
        );
        if (
          [...(json.buffers ?? []), ...(json.images ?? [])].some(
            (x) => x.uri && !x.uri.startsWith('data:'),
          )
        )
          throw Error('External URI unsupported');
        if ((json.extensionsUsed ?? []).some((x) => /draco|meshopt|basisu/i.test(x)))
          throw Error('Compression unsupported');
      }
      async function loadModel(readBuffer) {
        const token = ++request;
        status = 'loading';
        error.textContent = '';
        draw();
        try {
          const buffer = await readBuffer();
          validateGlb(buffer);
          const gltf = await loader.parseAsync(buffer, '');
          if (disposed || token !== request) {
            release(gltf.scene);
            return;
          }
          restoreSelection();
          clearMixer();
          if (root) {
            scene.remove(root);
            release(root);
          }
          root = gltf.scene;
          scene.add(root);
          meshes = [];
          root.traverse((o) => {
            if (o.isMesh) meshes.push(o);
          });
          const r = resources(root);
          r.geometry.forEach((x) => ownedGeometry.add(x));
          r.material.forEach((x) => ownedMaterial.add(x));
          r.texture.forEach((x) => ownedTextures.add(x));
          sharedAtLoad =
            meshes.length > 1 && meshes[0].material === meshes[1].material;
          status = 'ready';

          fitModel();
          if (root) {
            root.position.x = 4;
            fitModel();
            controls.target.x = Number(document.querySelector('#value').value);
            controls.update();
          }
          invalidate();
          draw();
        } catch (cause) {
          if (disposed || token !== request) return;
          status = 'error';
          error.textContent =
            'Could not read GLB. Choose a self-contained uncompressed GLB up to 2 MiB, or load a built-in sample. Details: ' +
            cause.message;
          draw();
        }
      }
      function sample(kind) {
        if (kind in samples) document.querySelector('#model').value = kind;
        return loadModel(() =>
          kind === 'invalid'
            ? new TextEncoder().encode('invalid-glb').buffer
            : Uint8Array.from(atob(samples[kind]), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer,
        );
      }
      on('#sample', 'click', () => {
        document.querySelector('#file').value = '';
        sample(document.querySelector('#model').value);
      });
      on('#invalid', 'click', () => sample('invalid'));
      on('#file', 'change', (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (file) loadModel(() => file.arrayBuffer());
      });
      sample('static');
      function report() {
        output.textContent =
          'State: ' +
          status +
          ' / meshes: ' +
          meshes.length +
          ' / shared at load: ' +
          sharedAtLoad +
          ' / frames: ' +
          frames +
          ' / target: ' +
          controls.target.toArray().map((x) => x.toFixed(2)) +
          ' / damping: ' +
          controls.enableDamping +
          ' / demand: ' +
          demand;
      }
      function draw() {
        if (disposed || !stage.clientWidth || !stage.clientHeight) return;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        frames++;
        report();
      }
      function resizeScene() {
        const w = stage.clientWidth,
          h = stage.clientHeight;
        if (!w || !h || disposed) return;
        renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
        camera.aspect = w / h;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        invalidate();
        draw();
      }
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(resizeScene);
      observer.observe(stage);
      resizeScene();
      function cleanup() {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        observer.disconnect();
        events.abort();
        renderer.setAnimationLoop(null);
        request++;
        restoreSelection();
        clearMixer();
        controls.dispose();
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        for (const texture of ownedTextures) {
          texture.dispose();
          texture.image?.close?.();
        }
        for (const g of ownedGeometry) g.dispose();
        for (const m of ownedMaterial) m.dispose();
        renderer.dispose();
        scene.clear();
        output.textContent = 'Disposed';
      }
      on('#cleanup', 'click', cleanup);
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', cleanup, {
        once: true,
        signal: events.signal,
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

</details>

### API · OrbitControls.target

Sets the orbit center in world coordinates.

- `target: Vector3` — Default (0,0,0); X=4 here

Mutates the same target Vector3.

- Call update after manually changing camera or target.

```js
controls.target.set(4,0,0);controls.update();
```

[OrbitControls.target](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/OrbitControls.html) · three@0.186.1 · 2026-10-27

### API · OrbitControls.update

Applies damping/camera changes and reports whether the view changed.

- `deltaTime: number | null` — Optional seconds interval; this example uses default null

In installed 0.186.1, returns true when changed.

- Keep updating during damping, then let input reschedule after settling.

```js
const moving=controls.update();draw();if(!demand||moving)invalidate();
```

[OrbitControls.update](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/OrbitControls.html) · three@0.186.1 · 2026-10-27
